originalTitle: NY Fed says supply chain pressures eased in June
simplifiedContent: The New York Fed, which is part of the US central bank, keeps track of how well global supply chains are working. In June, they found that things were getting a bit better, with their index score going down to 1.25. This is because there were fewer problems in the Middle East that were causing delays. As a result, it's expected that prices might not rise as quickly, which could be good news for consumers. However, some issues like delays and bottlenecks are still causing problems, so things aren't completely back to normal yet.

originalTitle: EasyJet shares reveal deal risk as $7.3 billion takeover advances
simplifiedContent: EasyJet, an airline company, has agreed to be taken over by another company called Castlelake for £5.5 billion. This means that Castlelake wants to buy EasyJet, and the deal is moving forward. However, even though the news made EasyJet's stock price go up, it's still not as high as the price that Castlelake is offering, because some people are worried that the deal might not happen due to rules and regulations. The deal is not final yet and needs to be approved by regulators and shareholders, and Castlelake has to make a formal offer by August 3. This uncertainty is making investors cautious, which is why the stock price hasn't reached the offer price yet.

originalTitle: TeraWulf jumps on $19 billion data center lease deal with Anthropic
simplifiedContent: TeraWulf, a company that used to focus on bitcoin mining, has made a big deal with Anthropic to lease space for artificial intelligence (AI) data centers. This deal is significant because it guarantees TeraWulf will receive about $19 billion in revenue over the next 20 years. As a result, the company's stock price rose by over 10%, meaning investors are excited about the news. The deal is part of TeraWulf's plan to move away from bitcoin mining and towards AI services, and the company will also sell some of its other assets to free up more money. This change in direction and the new deal are likely to have a big impact on TeraWulf's future.

originalTitle: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold tops $4,200, silver nears $64 as recovery rally extends; Fed minutes in focus
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: the prices of gold and silver have gone up a bit. Gold reached $4,215 and silver reached $63.73, which is a good sign after they had gone down before. This is partly because people are less worried that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates, and also because the US dollar isn't doing as well. This matters because it shows that investors are feeling more positive about gold and silver, which could be a good sign for people who own these investments. The prices are expected to be influenced by upcoming news from the Federal Reserve, which will release meeting minutes soon.

originalTitle: Trent Q1 business update: Revenue grows 19%, store network expands
simplifiedContent: Trent, a company owned by the Tata Group, had a good first quarter with its sales increasing by 19% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹5,666 crore. The company also added more stores, now having a total of 1,312 outlets. This news is important because it shows that Trent is growing and expanding its business. The company's stock price (or share value) also went up by 17.2% this year, although it's still not at its highest point ever. This increase in stock price is a positive sign for investors who own Trent shares.

originalTitle: Rentomojo gets SEBI nod for raising funds through IPO launch. Details here
simplifiedContent: Rentomojo, a company that rents out furniture, has gotten approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to launch an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means the company can now raise money from the public by selling shares. The IPO will mainly involve existing shareholders selling their shares, and the company aims to raise up to ₹150 crore. The money raised will be used to expand the business and pay off debts. This is significant because Rentomojo is a major player in India's online rental market, and the IPO could be an opportunity for investors to buy into the company's growth.
